name: Pregame maker
description: Posts two-sided post-only quotes at the touch on NBA/NHL game-winner markets from a few hours before the game until ~8 minutes before the estimated start, then cancels everything. Earns the spread retail takers pay while information arrives slowly pre-game; pulls a side after fast mid moves and caps net exposure per game.
hypothesis: Pre-game takers pay the spread and prices are calibrated, so a maker joining the touch earns (half-spread - maker fee 0.0175p(1-p)) minus adverse selection from slow news. Proven wrong if net-of-maker-fee pnl per contract has CI <= 0: the 1c tick leaves only ~0.06c at 50c, so the edge can only be in the price tails (cheap maker fee) or thin/wide-spread hours.
next: Rejected: mid-price touch quoting nets -0.09c/contract (CI -1.04..+0.84, 928 games Jan-Mar) after the 0.44c maker fee. Extremes-only variant continues in strategies/sports-tails.
